en: <CLT=cltMIND>At that moment...
...Huh?
Ah!

What...were you doing? Why were you in
the girls bathroom?

M-Maki! I-It's not what it looks
like, I'm just—
...Do you want to die?
N-No! Listen, there's a reason—

Wh-What!? Don't do that when I'm
doing my business!
I can't relieve myself if you do that!

...Himiko's inside?
And you were...in there, Shuichi?

Ah, okay, this is *all* a
huge misunderstanding...

Well...I guess you wouldn't enter the girls
bathroom without a reason...
...I'll believe you.

...Th-Thank you. Though it still seems
like you want to murder me.
Anyway...I found this.
Rantaro's picture! Thank you!

<CLT=cltMIND>I took the photograph from her and
inspected it closely.
Just as I thought...

<CLT=cltMIND>I sighed to myself,
looking over the picture.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everything was beginning to connect
in my mind.
<CLT=cltMIND>I finally saw through all of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lies<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Final Picture of Rantaro<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>With this...I can fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can fight the mastermind behind
this killing game.
<CLT=cltMIND>...And I believe I can end it all.
...You look like you just realized something.

But, what do you want to do now?
It's almost dawn.

Th-This is bad... We don't even know the
mastermind's identity or where they are...
It's okay. I have a plan.

Can you two please go get Tsumugi?
She should be in one of the labs.

After that, I'd like everyone to
gather in the courtyard.
I'll be waiting for you there.

Wh-What do you mean?
What are you planning on doing?
...Stop the killing game, of course.

B-But, we haven't even found 
the mastermind, so how—

...We can talk about that later. We don't have
much time left, so let's hurry and find Tsumugi.
O-Oh...I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>I stood and watched Himiko and Maki
go off to find Tsumugi.

Alright...to the courtyard. But before
I stop this killing game...

I need to stop the destruction
of the Ultimate Academy.

What is going on in this bathroom? Does it
have something to do with the hidden room?

Once you go in, you'll understand...
Seeing is believing.
Follow me...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko gestured me closer and
walked into the girls bathroom.
The girls bathroom, huh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Not the boys bathroom...
it had to be the girls bathroom.

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't have time
for modesty now.

This is an emergency. Nothing I
can do about that...

Ah, now's not the time to be thinking
about boys and girls bathrooms...
...Alright, I'll do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I repeated several excuses in my mind
as I stepped into the girls bathroom.
